title: Gallstones: Symptoms, Causes, Emergency Signs and What Indian Readers Should Know
seoTitle: Gallstones Symptoms, Causes and When to See a Doctor
seoDescription: Most gallstones cause no symptoms; a blocked duct brings upper-right tummy pain after meals. Know the causes, emergency signs and India's regional risks.
excerpt: Why gallstones form, which pain patterns and warning signs need a hospital visit, how common they are across India, the Gangetic-belt cancer link in proportion, and how they differ from kidney stones.
